units.name: Orange Toolbox — Chop Saw Station (US General Pro)
units.location: Machine shop — under the Evolution chop saw, Roughneck lift table alongside
units.note: Thirteen drawers. Drawer 13 runs full width across the top; below it the box splits into two columns — odd numbers 11, 9, 7, 5, 3, 1 down the wide left column and even numbers 12, 10, 8, 6, 4, 2 down the narrow right column. Drawers 4, 6 and 8 have not been catalogued yet; one of them holds the shop tachometers, the stud scanner, the Foneso laser tape measure and the angle finder. Open them, photograph them, and add them here. The printed label on the box reads "Oragne Toolbox" — a long-standing typo for the orange tape wrapping its edges.
